change: Replace temporary heap vectors in existing numeric Bytes operations with local arrays bounded by their existing checked arities.

contract.before: Validate arity, collect receiver/arguments in a heap vector, register the call roots, then decode numeric indices into heap vectors.
contract.after: Validate the same arity and arguments, put the same Oops in a six-slot local array, register only its used slice in the existing root scope, and decode at most two indices or four record parameters into local arrays.
preserved: Same current Integer/Word conversions and their order.
Same receiver/argument roots across callbacks and GC; no private table borrow spans a message.
Same byte snapshots, result construction, errors and invalid-input behavior.
Bytes alone interprets its buffers; Id and language APIs are unchanged.

microbenchmark.scope: Existing Bytes operations through Id. Twenty thousand calls/sample, seven samples/process, serial ABBA. Automatic GC disabled for timing; explicit precise collection outside every sample. Results checked. Does not measure full application/GC performance.

validation: Full Oop core/compiler/GC contracts, including binary values, full-width reads and direct-dispatch negatives.
Byte ABI, external allocation and tagged-row owner tests.
Added five-argument tagged-record decoding with GC during numeric conversion; wrong arities and null arguments must fail before callbacks.
limits: Local CPU microbenchmarks, not a whole-language or startup speed claim.
Automatic GC is disabled only in the benchmark process during timed work, with precise collection outside each sample. Runtime policy is unchanged.
This removes native temporary-vector allocations, not managed Integer/Bytes result objects.
Only Bytes is substituted into the comparison prefix; installed user runtime is unchanged.
